transcript.text: In the real world, when you interview for a great role at a great startup, nobody is asking you to take a CAT exam. They're evaluating how you think, how you communicate, how you break down ambiguity and whether you can actually think first principles. So we have designed the MAT in-house, from scratch to mirror exactly how a founder or a CXO will evaluate talent and the format is also not just a test. It's very difficult. You will be solving problems, ask to sell an idea and explain a concept as if you are speaking to a 10-year-old. This is your chance to show the admission panel who you are and what you bring to the table. All the best.
